UI-16 fixture provenance: minimal projections of the imported Forever beta journal,
read-only on 2026-10-15, using the same method as the gold-ledger fixtures. Characters,
realm and machine names are anonymized; unused arguments/events are removed. Item IDs,
counts, times, sequence, hook shapes and inbox tuples remain evidence-shaped. No game
SavedVariables file or database is included. `transfer.json` retains an actual Copper Bar
send/take pair; its receiving machine is renamed separately to exercise cross-machine
matching. Focused Python fixtures cover missing evidence, stale drafts and boundaries.
